name: item-without-label-writes-name-null
reference: spec/engine-spec.md 0.56 `null` ("the entity (inside a group, the item) does not hold the key") and ruling 3 (null inside a group writes the member null in the item). Item members in field-line order name, q; q has no null and an item without it does not write it, so the third item is {"name":null}, not {} (0.7). Derived by hand.
